This is directly copied from Clause [2], which states multiple times (e.g., under “1 > else if RRCReconfiguration is received via NR” and “2 > else if the UE is unable to comply with (part of) the configuration included in the RRCReconfiguration message received over the SRB1…”), and is further reinforced by NOTE 2:

Also explicitly referenced in Clause [5]:  
**"else if the UE initiates transmission of the SCGFailureInformationNR message due to Reconfiguration failure of NR RRC reconfiguration message: 2 > set the failureType as scg-reconfigFailure"**,  
and in Clause [6]:  
**"upon SCG configuration failure, in accordance with clause 5.3.5.8.2"**,
